يهتلكون (form VIII)
# يَهْتَلِكُونَ (yahtalikūna) /jah.ta.li.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# يُهْتَلَكُونَ (yuhtalakūna) /juh.ta.la.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
